== Overview & Architectural Fit ==
'''PySR''' (interfaced via Python to the high-performance Julia backend '''SymbolicRegression.jl''') is an open-source symbolic regression framework utilizing Multi-Population Genetic Algorithms and Pareto Frontier optimization. In the [[The Principia Machina|Principia Machina]] architecture, PySR addresses the inverse theoretical problem: given a field dataset or trajectory simulation, what analytical scalar expression or Lagrangian density <math>\mathcal{L}(q, \dot{q}, t)</math> or <math>\mathcal{L}(\phi, \partial_\mu \phi)</math> governs the system?

== Mathematical Evaluation for TPM & SVD ==
* '''Lagrangian & Action Discovery (9.5/10):''' PySR can search candidate functional spaces for invariant quantities. By setting loss functions to penalize violations of Euler-Lagrange dynamics or Hamilton's principle (<math>\delta S = 0</math>), PySR directly extracts analytical scalar Lagrangians from observational state trajectories.
* '''Pareto Complexity Optimization:''' Automatically balances accuracy against expression complexity using score metrics:
<math display="block">\text{Score} = -\frac{\Delta \log(\text{MSE})}{\Delta \text{Complexity}}</math>
This directly prevents the discovery of unphysical "overfitted" mathematical artifacts.
* '''Custom Operator Ingestion:''' Supports specialized physical operators (e.g., spatial gradients <math>\nabla \phi</math>, d'Alembertian operators <math>\Box \phi</math>, or relativistic dot products <math>u^\mu u_\mu</math>).

== SVD Integration Pipeline ==
# '''Data Generation:''' Extract spatial perturbation profiles from vacuum disturbance simulations.
# '''Operator Set Specification:''' Define admissible operators <math>\{+, -, \times, \div, \nabla, \partial_t, \text{exp}\}</math>.
# '''Variational Loss Enforcement:''' Evaluate candidates against action stationarity constraints.
# '''Analytical Verification:''' Pass discovered symbolic candidate expressions to [[The Principia Machina/Tools/Cadabra2|Cadabra2]] for formal Noether symmetry evaluation.
